segments.sn24.44:1.2: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.44:2.3: Vedanāya sati … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.44:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.44:3.2: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.44:3.6: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati, dukkhaṃ upādāya, dukkhaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.44:3.8: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.44:3.12: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.44:3.16: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati, dukkhaṃ upādāya, dukkhaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.44:4.1: Vātaṃ etaṃ mama so, attā no ca me siyā;
segments.sn24.44:4.3: Natthi karoto hetu ca, mahādiṭṭhena aṭṭhamaṃ.
segments.sn24.44:5.1: Sassato asassato ceva, antānantavā ca vuccati;
segments.sn24.44:5.3: Taṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ jīvañca, tathāgatena cattāro.
segments.sn24.44:6.1: Rūpī attā hoti, arūpī ca attā hoti;
segments.sn24.44:6.2: Rūpī ca arūpī ca attā hoti;
segments.sn24.44:6.3: Neva rūpī nārūpī attā hoti, ekantasukhī attā hoti.
segments.sn24.44:7.1: Ekantadukkhī attā hoti, sukhadukkhī attā hoti;
segments.sn24.44:7.3: Adukkhamasukhī attā hoti, arogo paraṃ maraṇāti;
